stages.title: Freeze the model
stages.scope: Two declared scalar models; nondimensional fixed g,kappa and positive branch.
assumptions: smooth local solutions and a nonzero leading coefficient

stages.title: Verify symmetry candidates
stages.scope: Parameter examples and exact Xc/X5 identities; first-order X5 obstruction. No independent maximal classification.
assumptions: smooth local solutions and a nonzero leading coefficient

stages.title: Select subgroup and rank
stages.scope: Singleton Xc is bracket closed; local projected and total rank are one.
assumptions: smooth local solutions and a nonzero leading coefficient

stages.title: Construct the quotient chart
stages.scope: y=log(t), z=s/t, v=phi/t; exact inverse and Jacobian checks.
assumptions: smooth local solutions and a nonzero leading coefficient

stages.title: Pull back jets and data
stages.scope: Exact jet pullbacks and compatible normalized three-jet data on s=t; the declared scalar density/source/flux and incompatible controls pass. Arbitrary physical IBVPs remain separate.
assumptions: smooth local solutions and a nonzero leading coefficient

stages.title: Certify reduced equations
stages.scope: Independent direct pullbacks at m=1,2,3,4; arbitrary-m scaling and first-integral identities.
assumptions: smooth local solutions and a nonzero leading coefficient

stages.title: Approximate the profile
stages.scope: Twelve classical controls regenerated; 40 stored comparisons are historical, including 16 exhausted budgets. No training.
assumptions: smooth local solutions and a nonzero leading coefficient

stages.title: Reconstruct and validate
stages.scope: Local bed compatibility, exact reference-family rational tube, and independent second-/third-order controls. Candidate guards remain sampled.
assumptions: smooth local solutions and a nonzero leading coefficient

stages.title: Report scope and total cost
stages.scope: Source hashes, exact/numerical distinctions, failures and historical budgets retained; no measured neural speedup.
assumptions: smooth local solutions and a nonzero leading coefficient
